# Optical-property assembly and spectral integration {#sec-ch07}

A radiation band first combines opacity sources into one set of layer properties, then solves radiative transfer
at each spectral point. The final sum must use the same spectral measure as those solver outputs.

@sec-ch07-mixture derives the scattering-weighted mixture and its conservative-scattering cap.
@sec-ch07-spectral distinguishes spectral densities from interval-integrated fluxes and documents their accumulation.
The evidence separates native measurements already recorded from the record and algebra checks run for this manuscript.
